## 2. Regulatory Positioning & Statutory Disclaimers
1. **Independent Private Advisory**: BRNDNUR Advisory LLP is an independent private consultancy firm. It is NOT a government agency, court, or official branch of the Trade Marks Registry.
2. **Authority of the Trade Marks Registry**: Under the Trade Marks Act, 1999, all trademark applications are examined and granted solely by the Registrar of Trade Marks (Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India).
3. **No Approval Guarantees**: Statutory registration is contingent upon official examination, distinctiveness, absolute grounds for refusal (Section 9), relative grounds for refusal (Section 11), and third-party opposition proceedings (Section 21). BRNDNUR does not guarantee registration or promise fixed government timelines.

---

## 3. Statutory Fee Structure & Concessions in India
Under the Trade Marks Rules, 2017:
- **Individual / Sole Proprietor / Startup / MSME Certificate Holders**:
  - Official Government Statutory Fee: **₹4,500 per mark per class** for electronic filing (Form TM-A).
  - A statutory 50% fee concession is granted by the Government of India to encourage small enterprises.
  - To qualify for the concession, entities must hold an official Udyam Registration Certificate or recognized DPIIT Startup certificate.
- **Companies / LLPs / Partnership Firms / Other Entities (Without MSME)**:
  - Official Government Statutory Fee: **₹9,000 per mark per class** for electronic filing.
- **BRNDNUR Fee Policy**: Professional advisory fees and statutory government fees are always billed separately and transparently in writing before any engagement begins.

## 4. Detailed Services Catalog

### A. Brand Name Search & Availability Screening
- **URL**: https://brndnur.com/brand-name-search/
- **Purpose**: Evaluates proposed brand names against pending and registered marks in the official Trade Marks Registry database.
- **Screening Parameters**: Exact matches, phonetic equivalents, visually similar device marks, and overlapping Nice classification categories.
- **Benefit**: Reduces the probability of avoidable examiner objections under Section 11 of the Trade Marks Act.

### B. Trademark Registration (Form TM-A)
- **URL**: https://brndnur.com/trademark-registration/
- **Purpose**: Comprehensive end-to-end statutory filing assistance for wordmarks, logos, and device marks.
- **Stages Covered**:
  1. Pre-filing classification and applicant eligibility assessment.
  2. Document preparation (Power of Attorney TM-48, user affidavit if claiming prior commercial use).
  3. Formal electronic filing on the IP India e-filing portal.
  4. Issuance of official Application Number granting immediate legal right to use the ™ symbol.
  5. Monitoring formal examination and tracking status towards publication in the Trade Marks Journal.

### C. Trademark Classes & Nice Classification Guide
- **URL**: https://brndnur.com/trademark-classes/
- **Structure**: 45 international Nice Classification classes adopted by India.
  - **Classes 1 to 34 (Physical Goods)**: Covering chemicals, paints, cosmetics (Class 3), pharmaceuticals (Class 5), metals, electronics & software (Class 9), jewelry (Class 14), clothing & footwear (Class 25), packaged food & spices (Classes 29 & 30), beverages (Class 32).
  - **Classes 35 to 45 (Services)**: Covering retail, wholesale & e-commerce business administration (Class 35), financial services (Class 36), construction (Class 37), telecom (Class 38), transport (Class 39), education & entertainment (Class 41), IT & software development (Class 42), restaurants & cloud kitchens (Class 43), legal & security services (Class 45).

### D. Wordmark vs Logo Trademark Protection
- **Wordmark URL**: https://brndnur.com/wordmark-registration/
- **Logo URL**: https://brndnur.com/logo-trademark-registration/
- **Wordmark Protection**: Protects the text and spelling of the brand name itself in any standard font, style, color, or casing. Offers the broadest defense against unauthorized commercial use.
- **Logo / Device Mark Protection**: Protects the distinctive graphic arrangement, typography styling, emblem, or badge. Essential for distinctive packaging and brand recognition.

### E. Trademark Renewal & Journal Monitoring
- **Renewal URL**: https://brndnur.com/trademark-renewal/
- **Monitoring URL**: https://brndnur.com/trademark-monitoring/
- **Renewal**: Trademarks in India remain valid for 10 years from the date of application. Timely renewal (within 6 months before expiry via Form TM-R) ensures indefinite perpetual protection.
- **Monitoring**: Weekly automated surveillance of the Trade Marks Journal during the statutory 4-month opposition window allows brand owners to discover conflicting competitor marks and file notice of opposition (Form TM-O) before registration is granted.

### F. Business Compliance & Registrations
- **GST Registration (URL: https://brndnur.com/gst-registration/)**: Mandatory for businesses exceeding turnover thresholds (₹40 lakhs for goods, ₹20 lakhs for services) or engaging in interstate e-commerce.
- **Udyam / MSME Registration (URL: https://brndnur.com/udyam-msme-registration/)**: Official Central Government registration providing statutory eligibility for priority credit, public procurement preferences, and the 50% trademark government fee discount.
- **FSSAI Food Safety Registration (URL: https://brndnur.com/fssai-registration/)**: Statutory requirement for all food business operators (FBOs), cloud kitchens, restaurants, and packaged food manufacturers under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
- **Business Setup Advisory (URL: https://brndnur.com/business-setup/)**: Commercial structuring guidance evaluating sole proprietorship, partnership, Limited Liability Partnership (LLP), and Private Limited Company constitutions.

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions (Verified Legal Facts)
1. **What is a trademark?** A trademark protects a distinctive word, phrase, logo, or commercial symbol used to distinguish goods or services in commerce. Registration under the Trade Marks Act, 1999 grants statutory nationwide exclusivity.
2. **When can I use the ™ symbol vs the ® symbol?** The ™ symbol can be used immediately upon filing an application and receiving an official acknowledgement receipt. The registered symbol ® may ONLY be displayed after the Trade Marks Registry has officially issued the Certificate of Registration.
3. **Is trademark registration the same as company or GST registration?** No. Registering a company, LLP, firm, or GST account establishes an entity for corporate and taxation purposes with State or Central authorities, but does NOT grant proprietary intellectual property rights over the brand name.
4. **How long does trademark protection last?** Registered trademarks in India are valid for 10 years from the original application filing date and can be renewed indefinitely every 10 years.
5. **Can anyone file a trademark application?** Yes. Individuals, sole proprietors, partnership firms, LLPs, Private Limited companies, trusts, and societies are eligible applicants.
